name: FSL DTIFIT
summary: Fits the diffusion tensor to a DWI with FSL dtifit, optionally on a single extracted shell and with kurtosis, WLS or SSE options, and outputs FA, MD, AD and RD maps.
description: Unless multishell is true, extracts the b=0 and chosen shell with MRtrix3 dwiextract; computes a brain mask with FSL bet on the mean b0 if none is given; runs dtifit with the selected flags; and writes fa, md, ad (L1) and rd ((L2+L3)/2) maps, plus kurtosis for multi-shell kurtosis fits. Use it to obtain standard DTI maps from preprocessed DWI. Needs a preprocessed DWI containing the requested shell.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
The brainmask of the DWI datatype (optional). If not inputted, will be fit using FSL BET

outputs.description: Tensor maps fa.nii.gz, md.nii.gz, ad.nii.gz and rd.nii.gz (and kurtosis.nii.gz for multi-shell kurtosis fits).

parameters.description: If true, will fit tensor using the -kurt flag
If true, will fit tensor using the -kurtdir flag
The gradient (i.e. shell) to use to fit the DTI model to
If true, will fit tensor using the -wls flag
If true, will fit tensor using the -sse flag
If true, will fit tensor using the -gradnonlin flag
If true, will fit multi-shell tensor

failure_modes.fix: Check that the requested shell exists in the bvals and that bvecs/bvals match the DWI.
